notes: PrefLib file 00022-00000001.toi (dataset 00022, 'sl'). Counting rule, as far as we know: Instant runoff, single-winner. 47 ballots with two or more candidates tied at one rank were left out (not counted as blank). A 'Write-In' candidate stands for all write-in votes combined.

label_sources.official_winners: City of San Leandro council agendas list "Mayor Stephen H. Cassidy" from 2011 (https://weblink.sanleandro.org/).
label_sources.max_ranks: Alameda County and San Francisco ranked-choice ballots allowed 3 rankings (every ballot in the file has 3 or fewer ranks).
